text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (—Whenever I see the morning sun, I remember.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(What my father taught me
on that day—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"—Listen to me, Bamboo!
You gotta find yourself a 'dream' someday too!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
A burning "dream" like the sun—
one that gives you strength just thinking about it,
and gives you courage when times are tough!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
The reason Dad was able to fight through those fierce days with his rival
was because within both their hearts,
there was a true "dream" that bound the two of them together!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
A “dream” will definitely help you grow!
It will bring you precious encounters!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't have to be right now! There's no need to rush!
Just make sure that one day, you find a 'dream' you can truly believe in!"

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just like Dad, I'm definitely
gonna find my own "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
Alright then, break time's over!
—Back to our passionate early-morning training!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(—Dad!
It all finally begins today!
My journey... toward my "dream"!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Time to psych ourselves up!
Starting with this morning's Disciplinary Committee patrol!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Blaze on!
Bamboo! Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our Twinkle Series challenge
with Bamboo Memory is
officially underway...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To walk alongside Bamboo Memory and her blazing fighting spirit, I need to fire up my own soul, too...! Pumped up with determination, I headed to the Academy—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Good morning!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is greeting the arriving Umamusume
at the top of her lungs...!
It appears to be part of her Disciplinary Committee duties.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
Bamboo Memory-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
What a wonderful greeting!
Let's do our best today too!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Hey—
You over there who just yawned!
Your ribbon's crooked, y'know!!"

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ack, the Disciplinary Committee head...!
I-I'll fix it right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Messy clothes mean a messy mind, sir!
Straighten your collar! Stay energetic and fired up!
Let's give today our all, sir!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Ye~s...
choice_data_list: You're working hard early this morning.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gooood morning!!" his tone bursting with energy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, as expected of you, Trainer!
Now that's a refreshing greeting!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer?! Me too!
Just thinking that today marks the start of the heated days
leading up to my debut gets me all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"However! Until afternoon training starts, I'll fulfill my duties on the Discipline Committee to the fullest!
This is an important job for me too, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, a desire welled up within me to learn
more about Bamboo Memory as we walked this path together—
choice_data_list: Since I have the chance, I'd love to see the disciplinary committee in action.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I mean, of course that's fine with me, but...
What's this all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: I wanted to know more about Bamboo Memory

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm a bit embarrassed, but
if that's the case, roger that!! Please be sure to watch
me do my duties as a disciplinary committee member!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I got the chance to observe Bamboo Memory's
Disciplinary Committee duties up close—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, you over there!
Plastic bottles don't go in that trash can!
Make sure you throw them in the proper recycling bin!

text_block_list.name: Panicked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
I'll be more careful!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Hooold it right there!!
Stop running while distracted!
Always pay attention to your surroundings whenever you run!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'm so sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! This is a public space!
If you're filming for UmaTok, make sure to check your surroundings and ensure everyone's safe!

text_block_list.name: Excited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap!
I-I'm so sorryyy!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo-senpai is at it again today.
She warned me once before too, and her voice was so loud it kinda freaked me out.

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Still, he's a super earnest and great guy, isn't he? Whenever you're in trouble, he rushes right over to help and listen to your worries... even if his voice is a little on the loud side."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Accompanying Bamboo Memory on her activities,
I often hear other Umamusume mention how reliable she is,
even if she can be strict.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely that comes down to her personality—
always so earnest and thoroughly sincere.
choice_data_list: (As a Trainer, I should follow that example too.)
(I should follow their example as a Trainer, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Observing Bamboo Memory's public morals committee duties made me want to face her with equal sincerity and enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the time for afternoon
training arrived—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Ooooooh!
Training is finally about to begin!!
I'll be in your care today!!
choice_data_list: Let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, with that in mind,
can I go for a quick run right now!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm already done warming up, so I'm good to go!
My body's just itching to move~~!!
Just one lap is fine! Pleeeease!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her motivation is exceptionally high, so
I don't want to hold her back and dampen her spirits here. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm on it right away, boss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory shows explosive acceleration the moment she starts running.
There's truly a brilliant spark in that raw power of hers...!

text_block_list.name: Tracksuit-Clad Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! Isn't that the Disciplinary Committee Chair
sprinting at full throttle?
Her acceleration is insane~!

text_block_list.name: Tracksuit-Clad Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is so loud and powerful! 
Seeing that kind of burning passion really makes you feel like, "I've gotta do this too!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...Incredible power, as expected. And what a remarkably lively run."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet!!!
Oryaaaaaaaah!!!
choice_data_list: You said just one lap, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our training with Bamboo Memory kicked off
with a full-throttle sprint, intensely underway
under the clear blue sky—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOU FOR YOUR HARD WORK!!
THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR TODAY AS WELL!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Time just flew by!
Before I knew it, evening was already here, so it was a seriously intense training session...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Someday, without fail!!
With the greatest rivals!!!
I'm gonna have the greatest showdown everrrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, sorry for starling you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see a gorgeous sunset or
a refreshing morning sun,
it just makes me wanna scream out my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Once again, to make this "dream" come true,
I'm gonna give it my all with full-throttle hot-blooded passion starting today!
I'm countin' on yaaa!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Nice to work with you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I know! Trainer, if you'd like, why don't you shout your "dream" at the sunset too!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fixing her gaze on the sunset, she takes a deep breath and puts the feelings welling up inside her—her current 'dream'—into words—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna make Bamboo Memory the strongest Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Together with Trainer!!
I'm gonna become a strong Umamusume!!!
HERE I GOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so began my days of fiery challenges alongside Bamboo Memory!!
